UNIT 01 · LESSON 04 · THE ALPHABET

One letter.
A little more confidence.

Listen, repeat, and learn to spell names and everyday words in German.

29 letter recordings are ready, including Ä, Ö, Ü and ß. Only the recording for X is still coming soon.

01 Listen02 Spell aloud03 Practise

01 / LISTEN & REPEAT

Meet the alphabet.

Play a letter, listen to its name, then say it aloud. Repeat as often as you need. A letter’s name is not always the sound it makes in a word.

Watch and listen.

Watch the video, then use the individual recordings below to repeat letters at your own pace.

Internet required. Watch on YouTube if the player does not load.

Practise one letter at a time.

German uses A–Z plus Ä, Ö, Ü and ß. Learn letter combinations in words as well: ei and ie sound different. Letter names alone do not tell you how to pronounce every German word.

02 / SPELL ALOUD

“How do you spell that?”

Yasmin: Wie heißt du?

Johannes: Ich heiße Johannes.

Yasmin: Wie buchstabierst du das?

Johannes: J-O-H-A-N-N-E-S. Wie heißt du?

Yasmin: Mein Name ist Yasmin.

Johannes: Schreibst du das mit Y oder mit J?

Yasmin: Mit Y.

  1. Start with these words: Name, Bild, Kaffee. Say each letter aloud.
  2. Practise spelling your name. Use the original lesson for recordings not yet available here.
  3. With a partner, spell a word while they write it down. Compare, then swap roles. The source suggests Buch, Fenster, Schwester and Vater.

Wie schreibt man das? and Wie buchstabiert man das? both ask how something is spelled.

03 / PUT IT INTO WORDS

Spell it. Write it.

Buchstabieren means “to spell”; schreiben means “to write”. Practise their present-tense forms.

Present-tense forms
Personbuchstabierenschreiben
ichbuchstabiereschreibe
dubuchstabierstschreibst
er / sie / esbuchstabiertschreibt
wirbuchstabierenschreiben
ihrbuchstabiertschreibt
sie / Siebuchstabierenschreiben
01 Wie ___ du das?

02 Ich ___ meinen Namen.

03 Wir ___ das Wort.

04 Wie ___ man das?

Finish by asking and answering “Wie buchstabierst du deinen Namen?” Say your name, then spell it aloud.

Source & adaptation

Adapted from Grenzenlos Deutsch, Lektion 4: das Alphabet, supplied as a saved-page ZIP, under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Dialogue and spelling tasks come from the source. 29 recordings were supplied separately; the recording for X is not included. Explanations are adapted, the present-tense table is expanded, and four new questions replace embedded exercises. The supplied YouTube video requires internet and remains subject to its owner’s rights. This page has no offline-saving feature; individual recordings can be downloaded.
